CustomField.description: Signed magnitude of declared-vs-verified variance, written by the Loan Application Financial Disparity Calc flow — positive is overstatement. Classified Restricted (not just Internal like the flag) because the percentage reveals the scale of the underlying financials even without the raw figures. Precision 8 (not 5) so a declared figure more than 10x the verified one cannot overflow the field and fail the save.
CustomField.label: Financial Disparity Percent
